title: Terraform module: Vault + Cloud KMS integration for Private VPCs
creator: Aditi Rao
description: Build a reusable Terraform module that wires HashiCorp Vault (HA or managed) and cloud KMS providers into Private (VPC) Redwood deployments. The module must: (1) support AWS KMS and AWS CloudHSM-backed CMKs (BYOK), (2) optionally provision an HSM proxy or configuration hooks for on-prem HSMs, (3) support secrets engines for Vault and integration paths for cloud secrets stores (AWS Secrets Manager / GCP Secret Manager) via provider-agnostic outputs, (4) create least-privilege IAM roles and KMS grants for services running in the VPC, and (5) expose health-check resources and telemetry to the Console for automated health and rotation monitoring. This ticket covers the Terraform authoring, acceptance testing (unit + integration), upgrade strategy for existing deployments, and documentation/workflow for customers switching secrets backends.
technical_notes: Module should be provider-agnostic but have opinionated defaults per cloud (AWS first): aws_kms_key and aws_cloudhsm resources, modular subfolders for aws/azure/gcp implementation shims

Support for BYOK: expose inputs for external key material import steps and KMS key policy adjustments. Provide automated helper script (non-destructive) to import EKMs and grant Redwood service principals appropriate usage rights.

Vault integration modes: (A) Vault cluster provisioned by module (optional, for PoC/QA); (B) VaultMount-only: module wires auth/mounts to an existing Vault address and configures KMS seal if provided.
Secrets sync: optional managers that create shadow secrets in AWS Secrets Manager for workloads that cannot call Vault directly. This must be opt-in and documented.

Health checks: terraform null_resource / external script that registers an endpoint in Console; health signals include KMS key state, HSM connectivity, Vault seal status, and recent rotation timestamp.

State migration: provide a Terraform 0.14+ compatible migration plan in module README. For critical KMS key renames, provide an explicit state move script example and guidance to avoid key re-creation.
RBAC & audit: module will emit IAM roles and CloudTrail/AuditLog config snippets; require customers to attach audit sinks as part of deployment.
Testing: Terratest for AWS flows + lightweight mock for HSM interactions; unit tests for plan diffs and drift detection hooks.
Security review: required before GA; include threat model for BYOK flows and Vault root/replica handling.
inputs_outputs: Inputs (examples): vault_address, vault_token_path, kms_use_cloudhsm (bool), kms_key_alias, byok_enabled (bool), hsm_proxy_endpoint, shadow_secrets_enabled (bool), allowed_principals
Outputs (examples): kms_key_id, kms_key_arn, vault_secret_mount_path, iam_role_arn, healthcheck_resource_id
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module compiles and applies in a test VPC with minimal perms and provisions an AWS KMS key and IAM role without recreating pre-existing keys
Module successfully wires an existing Vault cluster's transit engine and configures a KMS-based auto-unseal (if requested)
Health-check resource exposes seal status, last-rotation timestamp, and HSM connectivity; Console dashboard receives these signals in staging
Docs/README includes upgrade/migration section and a sample playbook for migrating from Secrets Manager-only deployments to Vault-backed secrets
Automated Terratest tests pass in CI for cloud flows; HSM flows covered by mocks and a manual verification checklist
Security review completed and findings tracked; gating variable to disable BYOK helpers remains default-off
testing_plan: Unit: terraform validate + check-docs scripts run in PRs
Integration: Terratest suite creates a short-lived VPC, provisions module with AWS provider creds in CI ephemeral account; validates KMS and IAM artifacts
HSM: synthetic tests against CloudHSM in sandbox account and a manual runbook for customer on-prem HSM validation
E2E: deploy a small Redwood service in the VPC to confirm it can decrypt a secret via Vault transit and produce expected metrics
rollout_plan: alpha: land module to infra-modules repo, mark alpha, run tests in staging (team infra account)
beta: enable for 2 pilot customers; run guided migrations with solutions engineering
GA: publish module with stable version, upgrade notes, and known-limits section
Rollback: module outputs include flags to disable shadowing and revert to cloud secrets while preserving KMS keys
upgrade_migration_steps: 1) Identify existing KMS keys and confirm they are not managed by older modules (state inspection)
2) Use terraform state mv examples in README to map old resources to new module logical IDs
3) If enabling BYOK, perform EK import outside terraform (by operator) then set byok_enabled=true to attach grants without key recreation
4) For Vault auto-unseal migration, create a short maintenance window and validate unseal keys in staging before switching
5) Run the health-check script post-migration and verify Console signals are green for 24 hours before closing the change request
